{{Attr|Tank}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Brain Bound''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Failed Gateway]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It also appeared in [[Containment]], but only when spawned by [[Corrupted Titus]]. It had a decently high amount of health, some defense and it was quite fast, being faster than the [[Pawn]]. It also occasionally spawned with the [[Bloated]], [[Aggro]] and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Brain Bound''' was a wooden construct with a brown body. It had a dark brown shirt and short parts that were also torn. It had multiple metal plates on its hands and knee-pads, all with various colors and grey spikes. It also had a metal head piece with wires and a lens on its head. ==Strategy== *'''Brain Bounds''' can be dealt with by strong, cost-effective early game towers, such as the [[Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Soldier]]. *Some '''Brain Bounds''' will have the [[Aggro]] attribute, potentially letting other enemies leak past. **Towers that can hit multiple enemies at once are recommended to prevent this. **Units from towers like the [[Crook Boss]] or [[Mercenary Base]] are also useful for dealing with leaks. *In Hard mode, some '''Brain Bounds''' will spawn with the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. **Towers with a fast firerate like the [[Minigunner]] can be used to deal with this. **Units' collision damage is a great way to deal with [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] '''Brain Bounds'''. Similarly, the [[Trapper]]'s traps will deal heavy damage to them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png|'''Brain Bound''' on the game thumbnail.
